title: Zesty Algerian Puff Pastry Bowl
description: A light, sour and velvety puff pastry bowl infused with a zesty chili sauce and fresh herbs, served in a traditional Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Lightly brush the puff pastry sheet with olive oil and cut it into 12 equal squares.
Fold each square into a mini bowl shape by bringing the corners together, sealing the edges with a fork press, and place them on the prepared sheet.
In a bowl, whisk together Greek yogurt, lemon juice, minced garlic, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Spoon a small amount of the yogurt mixture into each puff pastry bowl, filling about three quarters full.
Drizzle 2 tablespoons of chili sauce over the filled bowls, then sprinkle chopped cilantro on top.
Bake the puff pastry bowls for 12 minutes, or until golden and puffed.
Remove from the oven, let cool for 2 minutes, then transfer to a Korean brass bowl for serving.
Garnish with a sprinkle of fresh cilantro and a light drizzle of olive oil before serving.
